development: All 253 original 2023-2025 IPOs; the previously inspected 2025 period is now development data, not an unseen test
validation: Eight expanding 2024-2025 quarterly folds; training labels strictly mature before each cutoff
external_test: Unused 2026 original-cohort IPOs with exact profile/date joins, explicit original bands/lots, and previous-session Nifty inputs no older than 7 days
market_limit: Local Nifty source ends 2026-03-30; later IPOs are excluded without stale backfill
feature_policy: 8 compact / 12 context predictors available under the same definitions in development and new data; no unverified managers, financials, VIX, subscriptions or final issue price
price_target: Opening price / announced band cap - 1; training weights proportional to cap make absolute-error fitting reflect rupee loss
classification_reason: Correct the all-Apply degeneracy by evaluating both classes, while disclosing any accuracy trade-off
threshold_policy: Threshold and candidate chosen only from development out-of-fold predictions; scores used for selection are optimistic
external_policy: Freeze choices before external metrics; no retuning or feature changes after viewing new-data scores
baseline_policy: Compare frozen v1 149-row models, unchanged v1 architectures refitted on 253 rows, and announced-cap / always-Apply baselines on the SAME new IPOs
availability_assumptions: Archived announced issue terms carry the same pre-bid-publication assumption as the original dataset. Exact publication timestamps remain unavailable.

classification_guardrails.reason: Avoid sacrificing most winning IPOs just to improve balanced accuracy; guardrails applied to development outputs only before new-test scoring
